verdict.rationale: The evidence supports parts of a debugging workflow: a read-only explore/plan agent analyzes code (useful for narrowing down root causes), LSP integration gives the model code intelligence (corroborated by community users), and the GitHub integration can be asked to fix an issue and open a PR. Nothing in the pack explicitly covers reproducing issues or verifying fixes, such as running failing tests or commands and confirming they pass. Missing for 10: documented issue reproduction (running code or tests to trigger a bug), documented fix verification (re-running tests after changes), and hands-on evidence of end-to-end debugging sessions.
